scope: PNG-only inspection of all three native 1024x1024 grids (4x4 native 256 tiles); step 4000 grids also reinspected. No model loading or inference.

ema_psi_0_7: Recognizable adult masculine faces, black clerical shirts and white tabs; no obvious hats.
r1c1 still has dark poorly resolved eye sockets; r2c3 face remains angular and uneven around cheeks/mouth. Some individual faces look plausible at256px, but photographic detail remains inconsistent.
r3c3 appears slightly more legible around the eyes than step4000, a modest local improvement rather than a broad quality recovery.
raw_psi_1: r1c1 eyes remain opaque blurred patches, r3c3 remains distorted around the eyes, and r2c3 mouth/cheek contours are unnatural.
r1c2 no longer shows a clearly visible white collar tab; step4250 had a tiny gray tab and4000 a weak visible tab.
Other portraits retain collars and generally coherent hair/background layout, with no convincing increase in identity variety.
ema_psi_1: Qualitatively almost the same failures as the raw grid, including first-face eye distortion and uneven facial texture.
r1c2 tab is also absent or visually indistinguishable from the dark shirt.
No obvious hats; similar dark hair, oval face proportions, mild expressions and architectural portrait framing dominate.

trajectory_assessment: Across 4000→4250→4500, changes are chiefly contrast, expression and local detail. Persistent same-latent defects and narrow variety have not substantially improved. The later untruncated collar regression weakens the case for continuing this unchanged recipe.
recommendation: Recommend ending this unchanged CDC run after preserving a complete checkpoint, reallocating compute to the controlled alternatives. This is an opportunity-cost judgment from the observed trajectory, not proof of irreversible collapse or impossibility of later improvement. Root decides; no process action taken.
limits: Sixteen repeated latent samples per grid, not newly sampled distribution coverage.
No calibrated attractiveness, adult-age, diversity or convergence score.
No numeric checkpoint validation performed in this review.
Only new evidence files written; no trainer, model, input, or process modified.
